rof2_fire_construct_death_receipts.DDL:
CREATE TABLE `rof2_fire_construct_death_receipts` (
  `character_id` int(10) unsigned NOT NULL,
  `task_id` int(10) unsigned NOT NULL,
  `occurrence_id` bigint(20) unsigned NOT NULL,
  `accepted_time` int(11) NOT NULL,
  `accepted_slot` int(11) NOT NULL,
  `creator_character_id` int(10) unsigned NOT NULL,
  `creator_task_id` int(10) unsigned NOT NULL,
  `creator_occurrence_id` bigint(20) unsigned NOT NULL,
  `creator_accepted_time` int(11) NOT NULL,
  `creator_accepted_slot` int(11) NOT NULL,
  `native_click_sequence` bigint(20) unsigned NOT NULL,
  `original_item_id` int(10) unsigned NOT NULL,
  `original_item_serial` int(11) NOT NULL,
  `original_item_slot` smallint(6) NOT NULL,
  `original_charges` smallint(6) NOT NULL,
  `original_caster_entity` int(10) unsigned NOT NULL,
  `original_target_entity` int(10) unsigned NOT NULL,
  `construct_npc_id` int(10) unsigned NOT NULL,
  `construct_entity_id` int(10) unsigned NOT NULL,
  `construct_spawn_id` int(10) unsigned NOT NULL,
  `construct_zone_id` int(10) unsigned NOT NULL,
  `construct_instance_id` int(10) unsigned NOT NULL,
  `saved_at` bigint(20) unsigned NOT NULL,
  `claimed_at` bigint(20) unsigned DEFAULT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (`character_id`,`task_id`,`occurrence_id`)
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=latin1 COLLATE=latin1_swedish_ci

rof2_fire_run_actions.DDL:
CREATE TABLE `rof2_fire_run_actions` (
  `id` bigint(20) unsigned NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
  `shared_task_id` bigint(20) unsigned NOT NULL,
  `action_kind` tinyint(3) unsigned NOT NULL,
  `creator_character_id` int(10) unsigned NOT NULL,
  `creator_local_occurrence` bigint(20) unsigned NOT NULL,
  `creator_accepted_time` int(10) unsigned NOT NULL,
  `native_sequence` bigint(20) unsigned NOT NULL,
  `dynamic_zone_id` int(10) unsigned NOT NULL,
  `zone_id` int(10) unsigned NOT NULL,
  `instance_id` int(10) unsigned NOT NULL,
  `source_role` tinyint(3) unsigned NOT NULL,
  `source_door_sql_id` int(10) unsigned DEFAULT NULL,
  `source_door_packet_id` tinyint(3) unsigned DEFAULT NULL,
  `source_item_id` int(10) unsigned DEFAULT NULL,
  `source_origin_token` binary(16) DEFAULT NULL,
  `source_item_serial` int(11) DEFAULT NULL,
  `source_item_slot` smallint(6) DEFAULT NULL,
  `source_item_charges` smallint(6) DEFAULT NULL,
  `inventory_debit_committed` tinyint(3) unsigned NOT NULL,
  `state` tinyint(3) unsigned NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  `published_role_mask` tinyint(3) unsigned NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  `helper_entity_id` int(10) unsigned DEFAULT NULL,
  `committed_at` bigint(20) unsigned NOT NULL,
  `native_published_at` bigint(20) unsigned DEFAULT NULL,
  `terminal_at` bigint(20) unsigned DEFAULT NULL,
  `guardian_death_snapshot` mediumtext DEFAULT NULL,
  `terminal_actor_entity_id` int(10) unsigned DEFAULT NULL,
  `terminal_corpse_entity_id` int(10) unsigned DEFAULT NULL,
  `accepted_member_snapshot` mediumtext DEFAULT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (`id`),
  UNIQUE KEY `one_action_per_run` (`shared_task_id`,`action_kind`),
  CONSTRAINT `fire_run_action_kind` CHECK (`action_kind` in (1,2,3,4,6)),
  CONSTRAINT `fire_run_action_state` CHECK (`state` in (0,1,2,3)),
  CONSTRAINT `fire_run_action_debit` CHECK (`inventory_debit_committed` in (0,1)),
  CONSTRAINT `fire_run_actual_item` CHECK (`action_kind` = 6 and `inventory_debit_committed` = 0 and `source_item_id` is null and `source_origin_token` is null and `source_item_serial` is null and `source_item_slot` is null and `source_item_charges` is null or (`action_kind` in (1,2,3,4) or `action_kind` = 6 and `inventory_debit_committed` = 1) and `source_item_id` is not null and `source_origin_token` is not null and `source_item_serial` is not null and `source_item_slot` is not null and `source_item_charges` is not null)
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=latin1 COLLATE=latin1_swedish_ci

rof2_fire_run_item_origins.DDL:
CREATE TABLE `rof2_fire_run_item_origins` (
  `token` binary(16) NOT NULL,
  `shared_task_id` bigint(20) unsigned NOT NULL,
  `item_id` int(10) unsigned NOT NULL,
  `origin_kind` tinyint(3) unsigned NOT NULL,
  `state` tinyint(3) unsigned NOT NULL,
  `producer_character_id` int(10) unsigned NOT NULL,
  `producer_local_occurrence` bigint(20) unsigned NOT NULL,
  `producer_accepted_time` int(10) unsigned NOT NULL,
  `producer_native_sequence` bigint(20) unsigned NOT NULL,
  `source_death_sequence` bigint(20) unsigned DEFAULT NULL,
  `source_npc_type_id` int(10) unsigned DEFAULT NULL,
  `source_corpse_entity_id` int(10) unsigned DEFAULT NULL,
  `source_loot_slot` smallint(6) DEFAULT NULL,
  `native_item_serial` int(11) NOT NULL,
  `native_item_slot` smallint(6) NOT NULL,
  `created_at` bigint(20) unsigned NOT NULL,
  `published_at` bigint(20) unsigned DEFAULT NULL,
  `consumed_at` bigint(20) unsigned DEFAULT NULL,
  `consumed_action_id` bigint(20) unsigned DEFAULT NULL,
  `consumed_output_token` binary(16) DEFAULT NULL,
  `consumed_by_character_id` int(10) unsigned DEFAULT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (`token`),
  KEY `finite_run_item` (`shared_task_id`,`item_id`,`state`),
  CONSTRAINT `fire_origin_item` CHECK (`item_id` in (47748,47749,47750,47751,47752,47753,47754,47755,47756,47757,47758,47760,47761,47762)),
  CONSTRAINT `fire_origin_kind` CHECK (`origin_kind` in (1,2,3)),
  CONSTRAINT `fire_origin_state` CHECK (`state` in (0,1,2))
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=latin1 COLLATE=latin1_swedish_ci
